card.name: The word active in contraindications
card.fires_on: The word "active" right after "patients with" or at the start of a bullet in contraindication lists. It comes just before a condition such as bleeding, malignancy or infection.

modes.label: After patients with
modes.description: "active" follows "patients with" or "presence of" and precedes a disease or condition.

modes.label: Bullet or heading start
modes.description: "Active" opens a bullet item in a contraindications list.

card.plain: It marks the word "active" when a label lists conditions, like bleeding or cancer, in which a drug should not be used.
